description: Every app has two environments. PRE is where every change from this MCP and the dashboard lands (files, modules, rooms, theme, AI…); the developer plays it at a private link. PRO is what the users have: it never changes until this tool sends pre to it. Actions: "diff" — what would change (files added/changed/removed, settings that differ; differs:false means pro already matches; `promotedAt` is when the users last got a version; `queued` is null, except for a send made before publishing became instant that has not landed yet: { at, files, nextBatchAt, capped, failed, deployed }, which Neblla lands on its own within minutes); "promote" — "Pasar a pro": pre's files, server code and settings, as they are now, reach the users all at once, right now (returns { queued: false, live: true, promotedAt, files, message }; `settingsOnly: true` when only settings changed). Tell the developer: "Publicado: ya se ve" (published, the users see it now). Behind the scenes Neblla serves it at first and moves it to the CDN in a later batch without anything visible changing; nothing to wait for or report. A promote costs no credits. Confirm with the developer first; a rooms change that discards saved data needs confirmRoomsChange. "reset" — throw away pre's changes and go back to what the users have (confirm first). "releases" — the last versions the users had (Neblla keeps the last 10), newest first: { keep, releases: [{ id, at, by: { email, via: "dashboard"|"mcp" }, changes: { first, files: { added, changed, removed } each { count, paths }, settings: [field] }, files, rollbackOf, current }], queued }; an entry with id null is a release from before the history and cannot be sent again. "rollback" (releaseId) — send an earlier version back to pro, whole (its files, server code and settings as the users had them), at once, like "promote" (same answer: live, promotedAt…). PRE IS NOT TOUCHED: the developer's draft stays as it is, so the next "promote" sends pre again. The version comes back to the list as a new one with rollbackOf. Confirm with the developer first; a rooms change that discards saved data needs confirmRoomsChange. In git, each environment is a branch (the developer's repo when linked with neblla_git, else Neblla's, see neblla_versions): when the version goes out, pre's branch is merged into pro's. The app's name, slug, publishing and bans are not per environment: they change at once, for both. The moderators follow the data, like the players: a pre on pro's data has pro's, a pre with its own data its own (neblla_set_moderator).

confirmRoomsChange.description: For "promote" and "rollback": accept a rooms change that discards data saved in pro

name: neblla_promote
